title: Security Control Mapping, Continuous Assurance & External Audit Readiness
scope: Arcade repository, CI/CD, production synthetic reliability controls, incident/recovery controls, backend backup and disaster-recovery evidence.
assuranceBoundary: Internal control evidence and readiness mapping only. This catalog does not certify compliance with NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or any external standard.

frameworks.nistCsf20: Readiness crosswalk to selected NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 categories; not a certification.
frameworks.soc2: Readiness crosswalk to selected AICPA Trust Services Criteria references; not an audit opinion or attestation.

controls.title: Protected change path and least-privilege automation
controls.objective: Main is protected by server-side pull-request policy or an equivalent ruleset, while GitHub workflows use explicit minimal permissions.

controls.title: Immutable CI action provenance
controls.objective: Third-party GitHub Actions used by release-critical workflows are pinned to immutable commit SHAs.

controls.title: Reproducible dependency installation
controls.objective: CI installs dependencies from the committed Bun lockfile without floating resolution.

controls.title: Mandatory build and regression gates
controls.objective: Type checking, gameplay, scoring, leaderboard, browser and hardening gates execute before production deployment.

controls.title: Release artifact provenance
controls.objective: Production is built from the successful main CI head SHA and certified built artifacts are used for release.

controls.title: Post-deploy production verification
controls.objective: The live shell, PWA assets, game manifest and leaderboard contracts are independently re-verified after deployment.

controls.title: Synthetic availability monitoring
controls.objective: Read-only synthetic checks continuously test production availability without collecting player telemetry.

controls.title: SLO and incident automation
controls.objective: A defined rolling synthetic SLO and error budget creates and maintains a deduplicated incident surface.

controls.title: Incident diagnosis and recovery verification
controls.objective: Classified runbooks and independent recovery checks are required before automated incident closure.

controls.title: Guarded rollback and continuity readiness
controls.objective: Rollback targets are provenance-checked, manually authorized and non-destructively rehearsed.

controls.title: Encrypted off-site backup integrity
controls.objective: Durable backend state is exported through constrained OIDC, verified, encrypted to the offline recovery certificate and retained without plaintext.

controls.title: Full-stack cold restore verification
controls.objective: A fresh isolated database, production handler and real frontend are recovered and checked without production traffic switching.

controls.title: Offline recovery-key decryptability
controls.objective: The real retained encrypted backup is periodically decrypted and restored using an offline key, with signed non-sensitive evidence.

controls.title: Recovery-key separation
controls.objective: The production recovery private key remains outside GitHub, Supabase and automation while the public certificate is committed for verification.

controls.title: Recovery data minimization
controls.objective: Backups exclude transient throttling and unused token state, and P33 evidence excludes recovered row contents.

controls.title: Server-side authorization and scoring trust boundary
controls.objective: Leaderboard writes, sessions and scoring policy are server-validated rather than trusted from the browser.

controls.title: Security reporting and operating documentation
controls.objective: Security contact, runbooks, recovery procedures and release contracts are maintained in version control.

controls.title: Continuous assurance and deficiency ledger
controls.objective: Control evidence is re-evaluated on a schedule, deficiencies are deduplicated, and audit-ready evidence packs are retained.
